_meta.purpose: Audit event class emitted when a tenant membership transitions from ACTIVE to REVOKED. Sealed in the revoked tenant's audit-chain only.

tenant_id.description: The tenant whose membership is revoked. Per ADR-0311 §B-3, only this tenant's audit-chain receives this emission.

revoked_by.description: Principal who triggered the revocation (typically a workflow-engine service-principal acting on behalf of HR).

workflow_id.description: The offboarding workflow that triggered this revocation.

credential_handle_id.description: The WebAuthn credential handle revoked for this tenant. OTHER credential handles on the same hardware-key are NOT affected.
